mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, potentially affecting quetiapine clearance and increasing CNS side effects; quetiapine may mask vestibular symptoms from tobramycin toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess for vestibular/ototoxic symptoms, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust quetiapine dosing if renal impairment develops.
